autoContext: Validates browseWeb action. Covers: url param (string, supports {variable} template), urlsKey param (context key holding newline-separated URLs — each is fetched and returned as its own '=== url ===' block), maxPages param (int cap on how many of those URLs are read), and maxChars param (int truncation limit on extracted text, per page). siteKey is NOT covered here: it writes a profile file under webactions/ and is ignored when urlsKey is set, so it belongs with the listSites/loadSite tests rather than this one. NOTE: requires internet access.

test_basic_url._comment: PARAM: url — full URL string to fetch and extract text from. HTML is parsed; scripts, styles, and noscript tags are stripped.

test_url_template._comment: PARAM: url with {variable} — resolved from includedData before fetching. Allows dynamic URL construction from previous step outputs.

test_max_chars._comment: PARAM: maxChars — int limit on extracted text length. Truncates the returned string. Useful for large pages to avoid overwhelming downstream prompts.

test_urls_key._comment: PARAM: urlsKey — names a context key holding one URL per line. Every URL is fetched in this one action and returned as '=== <url> ===' followed by that page's text. PARAM: maxPages — caps the list at 2 here, so the third default URL must NOT appear in the output. A URL that is refused or fails comes back as its own block rather than ending the action.

verify_results._comment: Confirm all browse results are stored in previous_data.
